ns0:metadata.ns0:title: Evaluate to true if the ind-def:family_test is properly supported
ns0:metadata.ns0:description: This definition is intended to evaluate to true if the interpreter properly supports the ind-def:family_test and all of its valid operations.

ns0:notes.ns0:note: It is important to note that the values used in this test definition are specific to a particular machine, and may not necessarily apply to your system. As a result, in order to have the definition return a result of 'true', you must either change these values to the ones found on your particular system, or you must configure your system to use these values.

ns0:criterion.comment: Test that the family_object is supported.

ns3:family_test.comment: Test that the family_object is supported.

ns3:family_object.comment: This variable_object represents the family that the operating system belongs to.

ns3:family_state.comment: This variable_state represents any family that is in the EntityStateFamilyType (ios, macos, unix, windows).

ns0:constant_variable.comment: This variable contains a regular expression that matches the regular expression '(vmware_infrastructure|panos|aix|junos|aws|iosxe|ios|macos|unix|windows)'.
